description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of ChangeVideoSize for changing video size
description_zh: 本文介绍视频画幅变换ChangeVideoSize的语法及示例
name: ChangeVideoSize

parameters.help_en: The video URL. We recommend using an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The width of the output video, in pixels. Valid values: 32 to 2160
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的宽度，单位像素，取值范围32~2160
parameters.name: width

parameters.help_en: The height of the output video, in pixels. Valid values: 32 to 2160
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的高度，单位像素，取值范围32~2160
parameters.name: height

parameters.help_en:
The crop type. Valid values: smart, fill, and cut. The specific meanings are as follows.

`smart` (Smart Crop): Intelligently determines whether to fill or crop based on the subject position, or partially fill and partially crop.

`fill` (Fill): Adjusts the aspect ratio based on the longest edge. The excess area is filled with a blurred background or color, or stretched.

`cut` (Crop): Adjusts the aspect ratio based on the shortest edge. The excess area is cropped
parameters.help_zh:
裁剪方式，可选smart、fill、cut。具体含义如下所示。

`smart`（智能裁剪）：根据主体位置智能决定填充还是裁剪，或者填充一部分，裁切一部分。

`fill`（填充）：按最长边进行画幅调整，超出部分填充模糊背景或颜色，或者进行拉伸处理。

`cut`（裁剪）：按最短边进行画幅调整，超出部分裁剪掉
parameters.name: crop_type

parameters.help_en:
The fill type. Valid values: image, color, and stretch. The specific meanings are as follows.

image: Fills with the content of a middle frame from the video, with blur processing applied before filling.

color: Specifies the fill color as an RGB value array, for example, red `[255,0,0]`.

stretch: Fills by stretching. If the aspect ratio adjustment is large, it will cause severe image distortion, so this option is not recommended.
parameters.help_zh:
填充方式。包括image、color、stretch。具体含义如下所示。

image：填充视频中间一帧的内容，填充前进行模糊处理。

color：指定填充颜色，表示RGB值的数组，例如红色`[255,0,0]`。 

stretch：通过拉伸进行填充。如果画幅调整比例较大会导致画面扭曲严重，不推荐使用。
parameters.name: fill_type

parameters.help_en: The tightness of the crop box. Valid values: 0 to 1. A larger value results in more content being cropped. Default value: 0.6
parameters.help_zh: 裁切框的紧凑度，取值范围0~1。值越大裁掉的内容越多。默认值为0.6
parameters.name: tightness

parameters.help_en: Required when FillType is set to `color`. Specifies the R value in the RGB color
parameters.help_zh: 当FillType取值为`color`时需要设置。表示RGB值中R的取值
parameters.name: r

parameters.help_en: Required when FillType is set to `color`. Specifies the G value in the RGB color
parameters.help_zh: 当FillType取值为`color`时需要设置。表示RGB值中G的取值
parameters.name: g

parameters.help_en: Required when FillType is set to `color`. Specifies the B value in the RGB color
parameters.help_zh: 当FillType取值为`color`时需要设置。表示RGB值中B的取值
parameters.name: b

VideoCoverUrl.description_en:
The output video cover URL.
This URL is a temporary address, valid for 30 minutes. After expiration, it will be inaccessible. If you need to save the file for a long time or permanently, please access the URL within 30 minutes, download the file, and transfer it to your own OSS or other storage space
VideoCoverUrl.description_zh:
输出视频封面URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
